notas.regra: People at level 2 or above propose a note, always with a source. People at level 1 or above rate it. A note shows when at least 3 people say it helps (2 of every 3 votes) and, among them, there are people who usually disagree. Nobody sees who proposed or who rated, and nobody who interacted with the post is notified.
notas.enviada: Note sent. It shows once the rule is met.
notas.avaliarTitulo: Proposed notes for you to rate
notas.avaliarDica: Rate the content and the source, not who wrote the post.
notas.nivel: Proposing needs level 2; rating needs level 1. Your level grows with account age and participation.

wiki.descricao: Rights handbook, contacts of community lawyers and the public defender. Community members edit; the history keeps every version. Only moderation sees who edited.
wiki.dica: No personal ID numbers. Only professional, public contacts (bar association, public defender, law office). Lines starting with “# ” become headings.
wiki.restaurada: The page went back to version {n}.
wiki.confirmarApagar: Delete this page and its whole history? This can't be undone.
wiki.vazia: No pages yet. Start with the rights handbook.
wiki.conflito: Someone saved before you. The new version is above the form and your text is still in the box: compare before saving, because saving again will overwrite it.
wiki.conflitoNova: Version {n}, saved by someone else while you were writing
wiki.vendoAntiga: You are viewing version {n}, an old one.

seguidas.descricao: Only you see this list. When a new reply arrives, you get one grouped notification. Up to {teto} conversations.
seguidas.vazio: You don't follow any conversation. Use the bell at the top of a conversation to follow it.
seguidas.indisponivel: Conversation unavailable (deleted, hidden or out of your reach)

busca.ajuda: Refine with tag:topic, c:community, de:@person, tipo:duvida and desde:2026-11-01. Date search never uses location.
busca.salva: Search saved. It became a tab up here.
busca.nenhumComFiltro: Nothing with these filters. Remove one to see more.

temas.descricao: Posts from the #topics you follow, always newest first. Only you see what you follow.
temas.vazio: You don't follow any #topic yet. Open a topic and tap Follow.
temas.nada: Nothing new in these topics in the last 60 days.
temas.verLinha: See posts from the topics I follow

pastas.confirmarApagar: Delete the folder “{nome}”? The posts stay in your saved items.
pastas.regra: Only you see your private folders. In a group folder, group members see and add, and nobody learns who added what.

perguntas.nuncaAberta: The question box hasn't been opened yet.
perguntas.regra: The queue goes in order of arrival. Anonymous questions only from level 1 or above, when the box allows it. No question may carry personal data (ID number, phone, email, address). Your name only shows if you want.
perguntas.mostrarNome: Show my alias with the question
perguntas.enviada: Question sent. It joins the queue.
perguntas.aceitarAnonimas: Accept anonymous questions (from level 1 or above)

lembrar.marcado: We'll remind you {quando}. Only you know.
lembrar.regra: A private notification, just for you. If the post is deleted or goes out of your reach, the reminder disappears.

serie.dica: Each post goes through the same rules. Up to 52 times or 1 year.

citar.irAoOriginal: Go to the excerpt in the original post
citar.naoAchado: The quoted excerpt changed or was removed from the original.

leu.texto: You haven't opened this post (or its link) on this device yet. Want to read it first? This stays here: nothing goes to the server.

erros.nivel: This needs a higher trust level. Your level grows with account age and participation.
erros.conflito: Someone saved before you. Open the new version and try again.
